name: Castle
description: New look for the king's castle (plan g-hrad-nova-grafika): three approaches on the game's 3 × 3 footprint, the gate on the gathering side, a platform for the king, the kingdom banner, gate torches and lit windows at night. The game keeps its current drawing until one is approved.

variants.name: Stone castle with corner towers
variants.notes: Curtain walls with battlements, four round corner towers (the front one crenellated: the king's platform), a gatehouse with a portcullis and a palace with a tiled roof.

variants.name: Castle with a bergfried
variants.notes: A tall square keep with a high timber stair (the king's platform on top), low walls with a gate between two towers, a timber hall and a stable in the bailey.

variants.name: Early stronghold on a mound
variants.notes: An earth mound with a palisade, a stone hall and a timber tower (the king's platform), a gate with a ramp. Closer to the start of the game.

variants.name: Level 1: thatched hall 0° (front-right)
variants.notes: Owner's render (14 Nov 2026), Castle Wooden hall on a stone base with a thatched roof, the stag shield over the door, two torches, a banner pole, a bench and barrels on bare ground. Drawn for 4 × 4 (owner 15 Nov 2026: levels on 4 × 4, 4 × 4, 5 × 5 and 6 × 6). View 0° (front-right), cut out of the owner's render and scaled to 0.3228 wide (the picture fills a 4 × 4 footprint). Front corner of the plinth set by hand; this view is the one the game uses.
